description: This is a test class for the CopyProjectActivityAPI, part of the Time plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It contains automated tests for the API methods such as getAll and create, with some tests for delete functionality that are not implemented.

classes.name: CopyActivityAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CopyProjectActivityAPI endpoints, including getAll and create operations, within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll API endpoint for retrieving activity copies with various test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides different test case data sets for the getAll tests.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create API endpoint for copying activities with various test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides different test case data sets for the create tests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete throws a not implemented exception.
